nodes.statement: Use one coherent binary joint law of H,M,J in V conditional on actual U=1, with the independently calibrated endpoint rates a=P(J=1|H=1), c=P(J=1|H=0), a>c, and c<j=P(J=1)<a. nodes.scope: One frozen V,H,M,J,A,U=1 endpoint and audit interface; both H classes have positive mass. Probability coherence, calibration and sampling are simultaneous, not separate adjustable scalar inputs.

nodes.statement: The aggregate conditional covariance R=(1-pi)Cov(M,J|H=0)+pi Cov(M,J|H=1) is zero in the same validation law. Conditional independence J independent of M given H is sufficient; an asserted cancellation requires independent justification.
